function: Enter the group names or individual names for the purpose of classification of shear walls for automatic design or strength verification.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Design] tab > [Type : RC Design] > [Design Input Data] group > [Design Parameters] > [Modify Wall Mark Data]
usage:
Wall Mark

Enter the group or individual names to classify shear wall members.

Name : Group or individual name that classifies the shear wall members (refer to Note 1)

Wall ID. List : List of shear wall member numbers

The shear wall ID numbers can be entered in the entry field directly by the user or by selecting (picking) with the mouse in the analysis model.

Operation

Add, modify or delete shear wall member names defined by a group of shear wall ID numbers.

The Add Button : Add the entered name for shear wall members.

The Modify Button : Update the previously defined name for shear wall members.

The Delete Button : Delete the selected name for shear wall members.

The Close Button : Close the entry dialog bar.

Note 1
When the Wall Mark name is not defined by the user, the program automatically creates the names as follows. A name can be as long as a maximum of 12 characters.
Name = "wM" + Shear Wall ID

Note 2
When the Wall Mark name is repeatedly entered for the same shear wall members, the Wall Mark name will be updated to the last name entered.
